title: Multi-document Summarization through Multi-document Event Relation Graph Reasoning in LLMs: a case study in Framing Bias Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Automatic evaluation using polarization scores from an article-level ideology classifier (liberal vs. conservative) to measure informational bias, and arousal scores based on an emotion lexicon to measure lexical bias. Human evaluation is also conducted to assess the usage of emotional/biased words and the presentation of ideologically leaning information.
